subject: How to save datatable shiny app (or DT::datatable) as html page?

messages.author: 68cac09f84c964d4
messages.subject: How to save datatable shiny app (or DT::datatable) as html page?
parts:
I must be missing something obvious, but I want to save a shiny datatable as a webpage and just can't see how in the docs.

If you use DT from inside RStudio, you can "export as webpage" but I need to run this and have it save out via script.
As far as that goes, I'd be just as happy to use DT as shiny and renderDataTable.

Does this have to be done via RMarkdown?  

Thanks

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: How to save datatable shiny app (or DT::datatable) as html page?
parts: If you have just a DT::datatable() object (call it "x"), then you can call htmlwidgets::saveWidget(x, "filepath.html") to save it as an HTML page.
